adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler explicitly allows non-organizers to add guests (`isAttendee` or team admin/owner) but then builds the calendar update client using the *acting* user: `const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user);` and `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] })`. The booking/event being updated is tied to `booking.userId` (the organizer) and includes organizer calendars (`booking.destinationCalendar`, `booking.user.destinationCalendar`, and `booking.references`). When an attendee (or other permitted non-organizer) calls this mutation, the EventManager will operate with credentials that likely don't own the organizer’s calendar event/references, risking failure to update the organizer’s calendar or updating the wrong calendar.
